name: Hard Rock Cafe
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Hard Rock Café in Innsbruck

** Experience the ultimate rock ‘n’ roll vibe in the heart of the **Alps** at the **Hard Rock Café Innsbruck**! Located in the lively center of the city, just a short stroll from the **Goldenes Dachl** and the **Inn River**, this iconic venue blends world-famous music history with authentic **Tirol** hospitality. Indulge in legendary **Hard Rock** dishes like the **Bacon Cheeseburger** or the **Classic Wings**, paired with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**. Don’t miss their famous **desserts**, including the **Kaiserschmarrn**—a sweet, fluffy treat you won’t find anywhere else! Live music, rock memorabilia, and a vibrant atmosphere make this the perfect spot for locals and travelers alike. Whether you're catching a concert, grabbing a bite, or just soaking up the energy, the **Hard Rock Café Innsbruck** delivers an unforgettable experience in the stunning backdrop of **Tirol**. **

Address:

** **Hard Rock Café Innsbruck** **Maria-Theresien-Straße 24, 6020 Innsbruck** **www.hardrock.com/cafes/innsbruck** **

Opening Hours:

** Daily from **10:00 AM** – **12:00 AM** (last entry at **11:30 PM**) **

Tipp:

** Book your table in advance—especially on weekends—to secure your spot in this legendary rock hotspot! 🎸
